details:
Post processing can be great, but what's not great is when world creators don't know what they're doing and crank up the post processing to physically uncomfortable levels. I personally have a few physical eye issues (light sensitivity, visual snow syndrome, and astigmatism in both eyes) which makes certain effects or certain amounts of post processing physically hurt, cause vr sickness, headaches, disorientation, and usually just general annoyance. The ability to turn down bloom is great, but this stuff goes way beyond just bloom settings. Prescription lenses aren't going to fix these issues either. So many world creators use post processing very poorly and a lot of them don't give you any way to turn it off. The ability to toggle post processing completely is such a simple quality of life toggle that I'm shocked the client doesn't have this built in after being around for years.

Another argument for this toggle I've been seeing a lot is that some people do not have a computer that can handle post processing effects very well, but can otherwise handle VR and such just fine.

Honestly at this point with how many worlds crank up the post processing effects, this is less of a "preference" issue and more of an "I'm actually going to vomit or have a seizure" issue. Please give us the option to completely turn it off in our settings menu.
title: Ability to Disable Post Processing in Options Menu
